intro.other-analysis: This page keeps the earlier analysis: social support, programme delivery, district needs and priority districts. It uses older methods and data that are not the latest survey.
intro.poverty-analysis: This page shows how many people are poor in each part of Rwanda. You can see where help is needed most.
intro.ai-engine: Choose a district and let the AI Engine examine available data, check sources, and prepare findings for review.
intro.nst2: This page shows Rwanda's goals for 2024 to 2029 and how close the country is to reaching them.
intro.evidence: This page shows how the aid programmes are doing: money sent, families reached, and results.
intro.programmes: This is the place to manage a programme: field agents, program members, jobs, and payments.
intro.cooperatives: Find cooperatives near you. A cooperative is a group of people who work together. You can ask to join one.
intro.cooperative: This is the place to manage your cooperative. You can answer join requests and see your members.
intro.government: This page shows the numbers for your area. Use it to see where people need help.
intro.agent: This page shows your work for today: the visits to make and the problems to report.
intro.beneficiary: This is your own panel. See your family, your cooperatives and your vote, your agent and visits, and your health insurance.
intro.jobs: This page shows jobs you can apply for, and how your application is going.
intro.map: This map shows Rwanda's 30 districts. Darker colours mean a higher number. Click a district to learn more.
intro.datasets: See where the figures come from, what each measure includes, and what the data cannot tell us.
intro.ussd-control: See who uses the phone service, how it is going, and any problems. You can end a session or block a number. Every action is logged.

menu.title: The menu
menu.text: Use this menu to go to another page: {{pages}}.
menu.textAlone: Use this menu to move between pages.

again.title: See this tour again
again.text: Press Take a tour any time. You will see the tour for the page you are on.

analysis-filter.title: Choose a place
analysis-filter.text: Choose All Rwanda or one province. The district charts and the Export file follow your choice. Numbers marked National always stay for the whole country.

analysis-findings.title: Read the main numbers
analysis-findings.text: These boxes give the big picture. They show poverty in Rwanda, the district with the most poverty, and how many districts are above the national rate.

analysis-poverty-chart.title: Poverty by District
analysis-poverty-chart.text: Each bar is one district. A longer bar means a higher share of people below the poverty line. The dashed line is the rate for all of Rwanda.

analysis-chart-eye.title: The eye icon
analysis-chart-eye.text: Look for the eye next to a chart name. Click it to read, in simple words, what the chart shows and what to be careful about.

analysis-chart-ai.title: The sparkles icon
analysis-chart-ai.text: Click the purple sparkles to ask the AI a question about the chart. Always check the answer against the source.

analysis-changes.title: Poverty Changes
analysis-changes.text: The empty dot is the rate in 2016/17. The full dot is the rate in 2023/24. The space between them shows how much poverty went up or down.

analysis-finance.title: Financial Inclusion
analysis-finance.text: Imagine 100 adults in Rwanda. Each slice shows how many use banks or other money services. These numbers are for the whole country.

analysis-data-note.title: The amber warning icon
analysis-data-note.text: An amber triangle under a chart opens a data note. It tells you, in plain words, where our figure differs from the one NISR published, or why a year is missing, so you know how far to trust it. Click it to read the note.

analysis-support.title: Poverty & Social Support
analysis-support.text: This part compares poverty with VUP. VUP is a government programme that helps poor families. Poverty counts people. VUP counts poor households. So do not subtract one from the other.

support-views.title: Three ways to look
support-views.text: Compare shows every district in rows. Prioritize shows districts on one chart, so you can find which ones to study first. Districts shows a table you can search and sort.

support-scatter.title: Read the Prioritize chart
support-scatter.text: Each dot is a district. Dots higher up have more poverty. Dots further right have more VUP. The top-left area, Review first, has high poverty and low VUP. Click a dot to see more and to start an investigation.

analysis-needs.title: Compare a district with Rwanda
analysis-needs.text: Choose a district here. The dark mark shows the number for all of Rwanda, so you can see if the district is better or worse.

analysis-priority.title: Priority Districts
analysis-priority.text: These districts have the highest poverty. They are a good place to start looking. They are not a final decision about who gets help.

analysis-sources.title: Check the sources
analysis-sources.text: Use these links to see where each number comes from, which year it is from, and who was counted.

analysis-export.title: Export
analysis-export.text: Click Export to save the district numbers as a file. Keep the year and the source with the numbers when you share them.

inv-form.title: Open a governed run
inv-form.text: Enter an existing investigation ID and geography. The engine checks your signed-in account and data permissions before loading it.

inv-tabs.title: Research workspace pages
inv-tabs.text: Use these pages to inspect lineage, record competing explanations, request bounded AI research, and review frozen reports.

inv-history.title: Run record
inv-history.text: The status, scientific decision, and manifest come directly from the authorized governed API response.

nst2-intro.title: The big goals
nst2-intro.text: Rwanda wrote goals for 2024 to 2029. This page asks: are we reaching them?

nst2-latest.title: Latest numbers
nst2-latest.text: These are the newest numbers from the national survey.

nst2-targets.title: Targets
nst2-targets.text: These are the official goals. Compare them with the latest numbers to see how far we still need to go.

ev-payments.title: Payments sent
ev-payments.text: This chart shows the money sent to families each month.

ev-journey.title: Payment journey
ev-journey.text: This shows the steps from joining a programme to getting money. Look for the step where families are lost.

ev-mix.title: Programme mix
ev-mix.text: This shows which programmes reach the most families.

ev-table.title: Programme table
ev-table.text: This table shows each programme's budget, delivery, and status.

pm-programme-select.title: Choose a programme
pm-programme-select.text: Choose which programme to look at, or look at all of them.

coop-mine.title: Your cooperative
coop-mine.text: If you are in a cooperative, you will see it here.

coop-requests.title: Your requests
coop-requests.text: See if your requests were accepted, refused, or are still waiting.

coopp-requests.title: Join requests
coopp-requests.text: People who want to join are listed here. Press Accept, or say No and give a reason.

coopp-members.title: Members
coopp-members.text: These are the people in your cooperative.

coopp-about.title: Your cooperative
coopp-about.text: If you are in a cooperative, you will see it here.

coopp-activity.title: Recent activity
coopp-activity.text: See what happened lately in your cooperative.

agent-day.title: Your day
agent-day.text: See the people you must visit and the problems to report.

agent-visits.title: Visits
agent-visits.text: This is your list of visits for today.

agent-record.title: Record a visit
agent-record.text: After a visit, write down what happened here.

agent-problems.title: Problems
agent-problems.text: Problems you sent to the office are listed here.

me-payment.title: Next payment
me-payment.text: See how much money you will get and when.

me-programmes.title: Your programmes
me-programmes.text: These are the programmes you are in.

me-complaint.title: Send a complaint
me-complaint.text: Something wrong? Write it here and send it. You will get an answer in 5 working days.

job-application.title: Your application
job-application.text: See how your application is going.

job-open.title: Open jobs
job-open.text: These jobs are open now. Press the button on a job to apply.

map-layers.title: Choose what to show
map-layers.text: Pick one number to colour the map: poverty, extreme poverty, how many poor households report VUP, or money access.

map-canvas.title: The map
map-canvas.text: Each shape is a district. A darker colour means a higher number. Click a district to open it. You can also zoom with the + and - buttons.

map-legend.title: The colour key
map-legend.text: This key tells you what each colour means.

map-detail.title: District details
map-detail.text: The numbers for the district you chose appear here. If you did not choose one, you see numbers for all of Rwanda.

map-list.title: Districts to look at
map-list.text: This list shows districts to study first. Click a name to find it on the map.

ds-intro.title: Data & methodology
ds-intro.text: Check each source's period, population, import status and limits before using its figures.

ds-list.title: Official source register
ds-list.text: Select a source to review its file details, import count, geography and known limits.

ds-dictionary.title: How to read the methods
ds-dictionary.text: Compare the survey and provider methods, and keep poverty figures separate from financial access.

programmes-subnav.title: Tabs
programmes-subnav.text: Use these tabs to move between agents, program members, jobs, payments, and skills.

government-subnav.title: Sections
government-subnav.text: Use the menu to move between the overview, program members, delivery problems, field reports, programme requests and cooperatives for your area.

gov-content.title: Your area
gov-content.text: You only see information for the area you look after.

member-profile.title: Your details
member-profile.text: Your own details, your household and the services you receive.

member-coop-switcher.title: Choose a cooperative
member-coop-switcher.text: You can be in more than one cooperative. Choose which one to look at.

member-coop-360.title: Your cooperative
member-coop-360.text: Everything a member may see about the cooperative. You can look, but you cannot change anything.

member-coop-members.title: Members
member-coop-members.text: All the members of the cooperative.

member-space.title: Cooperative Space
member-space.text: A light page for your cooperative: voting, news and meetings.

member-vote.title: Vote
member-vote.text: See where and when to vote. You can vote once. You will be asked to confirm.

member-agent.title: Your agent
member-agent.text: The agent who looks after you and your family, and how to reach them.

member-visits.title: Your visits
member-visits.text: The visits planned for you, with a short list to help you get ready.

member-insurance.title: Health insurance
member-insurance.text: See if your insurance is paid, how much you must pay, and by when.

gov-members.title: Program members
gov-members.text: The people in your area, with their health insurance status. Open a name to see the full picture.

gov-360.title: The full picture
gov-360.text: Insurance, household, agent, cooperatives and family for one person.

gov-coop-leaders.title: Cooperative leaders
gov-coop-leaders.text: The leaders of this cooperative and how to reach them.

agent-open.title: Open an agent
agent-open.text: Click an agent's name to see when they joined and the history of their application.

ussd-stats.title: Usage at a glance
ussd-stats.text: How many sessions there were, how many are live now, and how many ended with an error.

ussd-sessions.title: Sessions
ussd-sessions.text: Each row is one phone session with the number hidden. You can see the menu path, language and status, and end or block it.

ussd-errors.title: Errors
ussd-errors.text: The latest problems, so you can fix them quickly.

ussd-blocked.title: Blocked numbers
ussd-blocked.text: Numbers that cannot use the service. You can unblock them here.

ussd-audit.title: Admin log
ussd-audit.text: A record of everything an administrator did here.
